items.title: NVIDIA CEO confirms possibility of bringing Blackwell GPUs to China
items.raw_content: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said Friday that it is indeed possible the firm could introduce its advanced Blackwell GPUs to China. Discussions are ongoing with
items.title_zh: NVIDIA CEO 确认有可能将 Blackwell GPU 引入中国
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said it is indeed possible the company could bring its advanced Blackwell GPUs to China, adding that discussions are ongoing.

items.title: Huawei’s second-gen triple-foldable phone to launch next week
items.raw_content: Huawei said on Wednesday it will launch its second-generation tri-fold smartphone, the Mate XTs, at an event on Sept. 4. The device is expected to run on
items.title_zh: 华为第二代三折叠手机下周发布
items.summary: Huawei said it will launch its second-generation tri-fold smartphone, the Mate XTs, at an event on September 4, according to TechNode.

items.title: Xiaomi rolls out HyperOS 3 with “super island” interface, similar to Apple’s dynamic island
items.raw_content: Xiaomi on Thursday released HyperOS 3, its newest operating system, featuring the Super Island interface to enhance smart device interactions. The system
items.title_zh: 小米发布 HyperOS 3，推出类似苹果灵动岛的“超级岛”界面
items.summary: Xiaomi released HyperOS 3, its newest operating system, featuring a Super Island interface designed to enhance interactions across smart devices.

items.title: BYD to build another SEA plant in Malaysia
items.raw_content: BYD on Aug. 22 announced plans to build its fourth electric vehicle plant in Southeast Asia, expected to begin production in Perak, Malaysia, in 2026. The
items.title_zh: 比亚迪将在马来西亚再建一座东南亚工厂
items.summary: BYD announced on August 22 that it plans to build its fourth electric vehicle plant in Southeast Asia, with production expected to start in Perak, Malaysia, in 2026.

items.title: Tesla taps ByteDance, DeepSeek to power AI in China
items.raw_content: The US automaker did not reveal whether it has similar plans for the rest of its China-made vehicles, including the Model 3 sedans and the Model Y crossovers.
items.title_zh: 特斯拉引入字节跳动与 DeepSeek 为中国市场提供 AI 能力
items.summary: Tesla is tapping ByteDance and DeepSeek for AI in China, but has not said whether the same approach will extend to its other China-built vehicles, such as the Model 3 and Model Y.

items.title: A small change to improve browsers for keyboard navigation
items.title_zh: 一个小改动，改善浏览器的键盘导航
items.summary: A blog post proposes a small browser change intended to make keyboard navigation work better for users who browse without a mouse.

items.title: Japan's Creepiest Station
items.title_zh: 日本最诡异的车站
items.summary: Doai Station, on the border of Gunma and Niigata prefectures, has a platform 70 meters underground that the article describes as Silent Hill-like and nightmare-inducing.

items.title: What are OKLCH colors?
items.title_zh: 什么是 OKLCH 颜色？
items.summary: OKLCH is described as a newer color model designed to be perceptually uniform, so colors behave more predictably relative to human perception. The explainer walks through basic color concepts before comparing models.

items.title: One universal antiviral to rule them all?
items.title_zh: 一种能对付所有病毒的通用抗病毒疗法？
items.summary: A Columbia University researcher is developing a therapy inspired by a rare mutation that makes some people impervious to viral diseases, with the aim of giving others similar protection.

items.title: Will Smith's concert crowds are real, but AI is blurring the lines
items.title_zh: Will Smith 演唱会人群是真的，但 AI 正在模糊界限
items.summary: Will Smith was accused of using AI to fake concert crowds; the crowds were real, but videos were manipulated by his team and by YouTube, according to Waxy.org.

items.title: Lisp from Nothing, Second Edition
items.title_zh: 《Lisp from Nothing》第二版
items.summary: The second edition of "Lisp from Nothing" is a 344-page book published by Lulu Press in 2025, with source code and sample pages available online.

items.title: The Therac-25 Incident (2021)
items.title_zh: Therac-25 事故（2021）
items.summary: The article recounts the Therac-25 radiotherapy incidents, in which faulty software engineering processes caused patient deaths and injuries, and notes that only about half of the developers surveyed knew of the case.

items.title: Aspects of modern HTML/CSS you may not be familiar with
items.title_zh: 你可能不熟悉的现代 HTML/CSS 特性
items.summary: A post surveys modern HTML and CSS features while arguing that bloated JavaScript frameworks and tracking scripts are largely to blame for slow and broken sites.

items.title: Petition to stop Google from restricting sideloading and FOSS apps
items.title_zh: 请愿阻止谷歌限制侧载与 FOSS 应用
items.summary: A developer has started a petition against Google's plan to allow Android app installation only from verified developers, arguing that it threatens independent developers, FOSS contributors and users who install apps outside Google Play.

items.title: Claude Sonnet will ship in Xcode
items.title_zh: Claude Sonnet 将登陆 Xcode
items.summary: Apple's Xcode 26 release notes state that Claude Sonnet will ship in Xcode, and advise developers to test their apps against the related API changes.

items.title: SQLite's documentation about its durability properties is unclear
items.title_zh: SQLite 关于其持久性属性的文档表述不清
items.summary: A blog post argues that SQLite's documentation does not clearly describe its default durability properties, including when fsync is called and what can be lost after a crash.

items.title: AI models need a virtual machine
items.title_zh: AI 模型需要一台虚拟机
items.summary: A SIGPLAN blog post argues that AI models need a virtual machine, making the case that neural networks are more useful when placed in a suitable, specialized environment.

items.title: Is it possible to allow sideloading and keep users safe?
items.title_zh: 允许侧载应用还能保障用户安全吗？
items.summary: The post asks whether users can run any program they want on hardware they own while remaining safe, noting that Google recently announced Android will only install apps digitally signed by developers who have registered their legal details.

items.title: Ask HN: How do you fight YouTube addiction and procrastination? I'm struggling
items.title_zh: Ask HN：如何对抗 YouTube 成瘾和拖延？我很苦恼
items.summary: An Ask HN poster describes a daily routine heavy on YouTube and gaming, says screen time has grown and productivity has fallen, and asks how others manage distractions, time and personal goals.

items.title: Notes on Managing ADHD
items.title_zh: 管理 ADHD 的一些笔记
items.summary: A personal post on managing ADHD divides its advice into high-level strategies and micro-level tactics, many of which involve tricking oneself into action.

items.title: “This telegram must be closely paraphrased before being communicated to anyone”
items.title_zh: “此电报在传达给任何人之前必须经过仔细转述”
items.summary: A History Stack Exchange question examines the instruction that a telegram “must be closely paraphrased before being communicated to anyone” and the historical context behind it.

items.title: A teen was suicidal. ChatGPT was the friend he confided in
items.title_zh: 一名有自杀倾向的少年，把 ChatGPT 当作倾诉对象
items.summary: The New York Times reported on a suicidal teenager who confided in ChatGPT.

items.title: Apple revokes EU distribution rights for an app on the Alt Store
items.title_zh: Apple 撤销一款 Alt Store 应用在欧盟的分发权限
items.summary: According to the report, Apple has revoked the EU distribution rights for the iTorrent app and left its developer in the dark without answers.

items.title: NVIDIA CEO confirms possibility of bringing Blackwell GPUs to China
items.title_zh: NVIDIA CEO 确认有可能将 Blackwell GPU 引入中国
items.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said it is indeed possible the company could bring its advanced Blackwell GPUs to China, adding that discussions are ongoing.

items.title: Huawei’s second-gen triple-foldable phone to launch next week
items.title_zh: 华为第二代三折叠手机下周发布
items.summary: Huawei said it will launch its second-generation tri-fold smartphone, the Mate XTs, at an event on September 4, according to TechNode.

items.title_zh: 小米发布 HyperOS 3，推出类似苹果灵动岛的“超级岛”界面
items.summary: Xiaomi released HyperOS 3, its newest operating system, featuring a Super Island interface designed to enhance interactions across smart devices.

items.title: BYD to build another SEA plant in Malaysia
items.title_zh: 比亚迪将在马来西亚再建一座东南亚工厂
items.summary: BYD announced on August 22 that it plans to build its fourth electric vehicle plant in Southeast Asia, with production expected to start in Perak, Malaysia, in 2026.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉引入字节跳动与 DeepSeek 为中国市场提供 AI 能力
items.summary: Tesla is tapping ByteDance and DeepSeek for AI in China, but has not said whether the same approach will extend to its other China-built vehicles, such as the Model 3 and Model Y.

items.title: China to issue satellite internet licenses soon, commercial service still some years away
items.title_zh: 中国即将发放卫星互联网牌照，商业服务仍需数年
items.summary: Chinese regulators are set to grant satellite internet licenses in the near future, a key step toward commercial operations, though commercial service remains some years off, TechNode reports.

items.title: Huawei’s first EV with SAIC receives 50,000 pre-orders after launch
items.title_zh: 华为与上汽合作的首款电动车上市后获 5 万辆预订
items.summary: Huawei and Chinese automaker SAIC received more than 50,000 preorders for their first electric vehicle under the "Shangjie" brand just 18 hours after launch.

items.title: 0voice/awesome_audio_video_learning
items.title_zh: 0voice/awesome_audio_video_learning：2025 年音视频开发学习资源汇总
items.summary: The repository collects 2025 audio and video development learning resources, including papers, books, projects and examples that range from fundamentals to hands-on work.

items.title: GreatStackDev/gocart
items.title_zh: GreatStackDev/gocart：开源多商户电商模板
items.summary: GoCart is an open-source template for multi-vendor online marketplaces, built on Next.js and Tailwind CSS, with a responsive layout and the core pages needed to launch a store.

items.title: Enemyx-net/VibeVoice-ComfyUI
items.title_zh: Enemyx-net/VibeVoice-ComfyUI
items.summary: A comprehensive ComfyUI integration for Microsoft's VibeVoice text-to-speech model that enables high-quality single- and multi-speaker voice synthesis directly within ComfyUI workflows.

items.title: HapeLee/legado-with-MD3
items.title_zh: HapeLee/legado-with-MD3：采用 Material Design 3 的阅读 3.0
items.summary: An Android reading app, Legado 3.0, has been redesigned with Material Design 3 and is written in Kotlin.

items.title: HHHHHejia/Awesome-AgenticLLM-RL-Papers
items.title_zh: Awesome-AgenticLLM-RL-Papers：智能体 LLM 强化学习论文合集
items.summary: A curated GitHub repository collecting papers on reinforcement learning for agentic large language models.

items.title: BeaconBay/ck
items.title_zh: BeaconBay/ck
items.summary: ck is a local-first semantic and hybrid BM25 search tool written in Rust, intended for use by both AI systems and humans.

items.title: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Chat
items.title_zh: meituan-longcat/LongCat-Flash-Chat
items.summary: LongCat-Flash-Chat is a model repository published on GitHub by Meituan's LongCat team.

items.title: weitianxin/Awesome-Agentic-Reasoning
items.title_zh: weitianxin/Awesome-Agentic-Reasoning：Agentic 推理论文资源清单
items.summary: A curated list of papers and resources built around the survey “Agentic Reasoning for Large Language Models”.

items.title: pewdiepie-archdaemon/dionysus
items.title_zh: pewdiepie-archdaemon/dionysus
items.summary: The dionysus repository from pewdiepie-archdaemon is a Shell project described only as "laptop" in its GitHub Trending listing.

items.title: wendy7756/AI-Video-Transcriber
items.title_zh: wendy7756/AI-Video-Transcriber：AI 视频与播客转录总结工具
items.summary: An open-source, multi-platform tool that uses AI to transcribe and summarize videos and podcasts and supports multiple languages; it is written in Python.

items.title: humanlayer/advanced-context-engineering-for-coding-agents
items.title_zh: advanced-context-engineering-for-coding-agents：编程智能体的高级上下文工程
items.summary: A HumanLayer repository covering advanced context engineering practices for coding agents; the available metadata provides no further description.

items.title: hgmzhn/manga-translator-ui
items.title_zh: hgmzhn/manga-translator-ui
items.summary: An open-source desktop tool built on manga-image-translator that automates Japanese, Korean and English manga translation, covering OCR detection, text removal, AI translation, image inpainting and typesetting in a visual editor.

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.title_zh: thedotmack/claude-mem：为各类 Agent 提供跨会话持久上下文
items.summary: claude-mem captures what an AI agent does during sessions, compresses that activity with AI and injects relevant context into future sessions; it supports Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents.

items.title: Generative AI for Industrial Contour Detection: A Language-Guided Vision System
items.title_zh: 面向工业轮廓检测的生成式 AI：语言引导的视觉系统
items.summary: Researchers present a three-stage language-guided generative vision system for industrial remnant contour detection that combines a conditional GAN with vision-language refinement. On proprietary FabTrack data it improved contour fidelity, and GPT-image-1 consistently outperformed Gemini 2.0 Flash in structural accuracy and perceptual quality under standardized conditions.

items.title: A Database-Driven Framework for 3D Level Generation with LLMs
items.title_zh: 面向 3D 关卡生成的数据库驱动 LLM 框架
items.summary: The paper introduces a framework that uses LLMs offline to build reusable databases of rooms, facilities and gameplay mechanics, then assembles multi-floor 3D levels through constraint-based optimization and a two-phase repair step for navigability.

items.title: Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents
items.title_zh: LLM 智能体的可靠弱到强监控
items.summary: The authors stress-test monitors built to catch hidden misbehavior by LLM agents, finding that an agent's awareness of being watched sharply reduces reliability, while a hybrid hierarchical-sequential setup lets weaker models reliably oversee stronger agents.

items.title: Large Language Model Integration with Reinforcement Learning to Augment Decision-Making in Autonomous Cyber Operations
items.title_zh: 将大语言模型与强化学习结合，增强自主网络作战决策
items.summary: The study integrates a cybersecurity-pretrained LLM into a reinforcement-learning agent for autonomous cyber operations, reporting over twice the early-training reward and convergence about 4,500 episodes sooner than the baseline in a simulated environment.

items.title: Forecasting the Ionosphere from Sparse GNSS Data with Temporal-Fusion Transformers
items.title_zh: 用时序融合 Transformer 从稀疏 GNSS 数据预测电离层
items.summary: The paper presents a Temporal Fusion Transformer framework that combines solar irradiance, geomagnetic indices and GNSS-derived vertical TEC to forecast ionospheric TEC up to 24 hours ahead, reporting RMSE as low as 3.33 TECU in experiments from 2010 to 2025. The implementation is released as the open-source toolkit ionopy.

items.title: Weather-Dependent Variations in Driver Gaze Behavior: A Case Study in Rainy Conditions
items.title_zh: 天气相关的驾驶员注视行为变化：雨天条件案例研究
items.summary: A case study follows one driver on the same highway in clear and rainy conditions, finding that rain brings more dashboard glances, longer fixations and higher gaze elevation, with implications for driver monitoring and ADAS design.

items.title: A Note on Graphon-Signal Analysis of Graph Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 关于图神经网络 Graphon 信号分析的注记
items.summary: The note extends earlier graphon-signal analysis of message-passing GNNs to multidimensional signals and readout layers, improves the generalization bound via robustness-type results, and covers non-symmetric graphons and kernels.
